meta.source: MOEX ISS daily candles + local PostgreSQL price slices
meta.definition: Continuous up/down run = consecutive close-to-close changes with the same sign. Flat bars are ignored. Threshold variant ignores |ΔC/C| below the per-timeframe threshold.
caveats: Individual MOEX share history on TQBR starts 2013-03-25; IMOEX index starts 2003-01-04.
Si December contracts are stitched by year for run statistics only — this is not a rolled futures return series.
USDRUBF perpetual history starts 2022-04-26; contango daily basis therefore covers 2022-2026, not 20 years.
Minute intervals use local 2026 slices only; no 20-year minute history was downloaded.
Local equity H4 is synthetic and has only 24-27 bars per security; it is included with a relaxed 20-bar minimum and treated as illustrative.
Run length is counted in bars, not calendar time; daily bars are trading days.
